content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Three unsupervised anomaly detection algorithms—Isolation Forest, one-class support vector machine, and a shallow autoencoder—are evaluated on harvester drivetrain telemetry.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07235","field":"abstract","quote":"Three unsupervised anomaly detection algorithms—Isolation Forest (iForest), one-class support vector machine (OCSVM), and a shallow autoencoder—are evaluated"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Observations falling below the 1st percentile of estimated density were flagged as anomalous in hydraulic system telemetry, with computational overhead of 14 ms for density evaluation on a Cortex-M7 microcontroller.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07234","field":"abstract","quote":"Observations falling below the 1st percentile of estimated density were flagged as anomalous"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-07234","field":"abstract","quote":"density evaluation for a 6-dimensional observation averaged 14 ms"}]},{"claim":3,"text":"Both architectures are trained in reconstruction mode; anomaly scores are derived from mean squared reconstruction error over fixed windows.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07240","field":"abstract","quote":"Both architectures are trained in reconstruction mode; anomaly scores are derived from mean squared reconstruction error"}]}]}
